faqs.q: Who will come to my home?
faqs.a: Good Help Plumbing is run by Jared Stewart, a Kentucky licensed master plumber, and every person on our truck is someone we'd trust in our own mother's house. No call center, no upsell script - you get a straight diagnosis and the price before any work starts.

faqs.q: How long does a water heater last?
faqs.a: Tank water heaters in central Kentucky typically last 8-12 years - less with our hard water.
